title: Simple poolrooms kit
description: This project adds poolrooms tiles so you can build your own poolrooms! more stuff are coming soon.
body:
Simple Poolroom Kit

Create your own Poolrooms quickly and easily! This lightweight mod adds a collection of blocks and building elements inspired by the Poolrooms aesthetic. Build hallways, rooms, and structures with:

Tiles — smooth, dark, and standard options

Slabs — for raised floors and subtle details

Fully compatible with NeoForge 1.21.4 and NeoForge 1.21.8 Ideal for map makers, Backrooms fans, or anyone who wants to craft their own Poolrooms-inspired builds.

Note: This is my first mod, made with MCreator. Some features may still have small bugs.

If you find any bugs report it in the discord server with the link i provided in the links section.

The mod is in early access!
